01 / About

Analytical thinking, practical supply-chain work.

A portfolio built around logistics, inventory management, operations, and supply-chain analytics.

I am a 2026 graduate of Addis Ababa University with a Bachelor of Arts in Logistics and Supply Chain Management. My academic work combined operations management with quantitative inventory analysis and a practical three-month internship at the National Alcohol and Liquor Factory (NALF).

My undergraduate research focused on spare-parts inventory management, including FSN classification, EOQ and ROP modeling, safety-stock analysis, and carrying-cost analysis.

“Reliable, thoughtful, analytical, and very capable” — themes reflected in the academic recommendation supporting my internship, graduate trainee, and entry-level career applications.

BA in Logistics & Supply Chain Management — Addis Ababa University

3-month internship • National Alcohol and Liquor Factory (NALF)

Procurement & Inventory Intern

Completed a three-month internship at the National Alcohol and Liquor Factory, gaining practical exposure to both procurement and inventory operations, with particular focus on spare-parts inventory management and the connection between purchasing and stock control. The experience supported my undergraduate research using FSN classification, EOQ and ROP modeling, safety-stock analysis, and carrying-cost analysis.

Introduction to Supply Chain Analytics — TU Berlin / EMNET

Participated in a training and workshop covering descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive analytics; data-driven decision-making; analytics frameworks; supply-chain analytics methods; project conceptualization; and visualization and communication of analytical results.

03 / Projects

Turning inventory data into decisions.

Selected work from my undergraduate research and inventory-management focus.

01

Spare Parts Inventory Optimization

Applied FSN classification to a sample of 126 spare parts and used EOQ and ROP modeling for fast-moving items to support more structured inventory decisions.

FSNEOQROP
02

Safety Stock & Min-Max Policy Design

Designed Min-Max (s,S) inventory policies with safety-stock considerations for slow-moving items, connecting inventory-control concepts with operational needs.

Min-MaxSafety StockInventory Control
03

Carrying Cost Analysis

Analyzed the carrying cost implications of non-moving inventory using a 15% cost rate derived from company financial data.

Cost AnalysisNon-movingFinance
